purpose: Reference capabilities for mapping existing Website-owned physical-commerce implementations; never a storage schema or business-rule authority.

operationSemantics.products: publish changes a draft product to active; unpublish changes an active product to draft; archive is not the implementation of unpublish.
operationSemantics.orders: Every created order must be linked to one customer. Delete is allowed only for an unsubmitted draft order; paid, fulfilled, cancelled, and otherwise progressed orders use their lifecycle transitions instead.
operationSemantics.customers: Archive customers instead of physically deleting identities that may be referenced by orders.
operationSemantics.inventory: Adjustments preserve non-negative availability. When SKU support is present, inventory is owned per SKU rather than by one shared product quantity.
